# Initialize simulation
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data Al_structure.data

replicate 5 5 5

# Define interatomic potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-10 1.0e-10 100000 100000

# Output final energy
variable natoms equal "count(all)"
variable etotal equal "pe"
variable bulk_energy equal "v_etotal"

# Write relaxed structure
write_data relaxed_structure.data"}
